prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but I'm happy to answer your questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston, Texas, trying to make a left turn.

Q: What was the traffic like at the time?

A: It was moderate. The light had just turned yellow, and I was waiting to turn when the oncoming traffic cleared.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. I remember a car coming toward me, but I thought it was farther away than it was. I started the turn and then there was a loud bang.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How fast were you going when you began the turn?

A: I'd guess around fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I wasn't rushing.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes. I was taken to the emergency room. They told me I have a concussion. I've had headaches, I get dizzy when I stand up too fast, and bright lights bother me.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?

A: Some of them, yes. I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while, so I'm taking time off work.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?

A: I just want to make sure my medical bills and lost wages are taken care of. I'm still trying to understand how this happened.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we have reviewed the information.

A: Okay, thank you.
